clues.text: This steel attraction reaches a height of 180 feet and launches riders at 70 mph without ever going upside down.
Designed by the manufacturer Intamin, this high-energy ride made its debut at its current park in 2008.
You will find this ride in Pennsylvania at a park that is famous for being paired with a major 'Wildwater Kingdom.'
This inverted launched shuttle coaster at Dorney Park is notable for being the first of its model to feature a twisted vertical spike.
The name of this ride suggests that you have been taken over by a ghost or an otherworldly spirit.

evidence.quote: Possessed is a steel inverted launched shuttle roller coaster located at Dorney Park & Wildwater Kingdom in Allentown, Pennsylvania, USA.

Possessed is a steel inverted launched shuttle roller coaster located at Dorney Park & Wildwater Kingdom in Allentown, Pennsylvania, USA. ... This was the second Impulse Coaster to open and the first one with a vertical rollback (element)|twisted vertical spike.
For the following season, the name was changed to Possessed.
